# Pull Request

## Description

What this PR does, in a couple of sentences.

## Motivation

What problem is solved, what feature is added, what it unblocks.

## Changes

- Bullet list of the concrete changes.
- Remove this entire section if the Summary is already enough.

## Testing

How did you test this and how would I test this, if testing is needed.

## Additional Notes

Known limitations, things you're unsure about, what was deliberately left for later, or other additional notes.

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, etc.)
- [ ] `ruff format` / `ruff check` pass locally
- [ ] `ty check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated, if applicable
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or raw data paths committed
- [ ] Docs/README updated, if applicable
